messages.author: 71355347acce841a
messages.subject: Problems running bilat.symmetry function
parts:
I am trying to run:

#####################################################
ventral.land <- readland.tps("Mitesv.tps", specID = "imageID")
ventral.fact <- read.table("Factors.txt", header=TRUE)
land_pairsv <- cbind(c(1,3,2,7,9),c(6,4,5,8,10))
ventral.gpa <- gpagen(A= ventral.land)
gdfv <- geomorph.data.frame(shape = ventral.gpa$coords, csize=ventral.gpa$Csize, ind=ventral.fact$Individual, replicate=ventral.fact$Replicate)
ventral.sym <- bilat.symmetry(A = shape, ind = ind, replicate = replicate, object.sym = TRUE, land.pairs = land_pairsv, data = gdfv, RRPP = TRUE, iter = 9999)
######################################################

*ventral.land ==> 3D array (p x k x n) obtained from a tps file read with the readland.tps function.
*shape==> 3D array (p x k x n) coords obtained from gpagen function.
*gdfv ==> geomorph.data.frame containing factors+coords+csize from gpagen function
*ind ==> A vector containing labels for each individual.
*replicate ==> A vector containing labels for replicate (two replicates per individual to calculate the error and  corresponding to two sets of landmarks taken on different days)
*object.sym=TRUE ==> object symmetry analysis is indicated
*land_pairsv ==> matrix indicating the landmark pairs for object symmetry (landmark 11 is not used for object symmetry)

when I try to run the function I get this error:

Error in apply(random.shape.F, 1, effect.size) : dim(X) must have a positive length

Could anyone help me with this? 
Thanks in advance
Please see the files attached below.
